description: Invoke an action synchronously and return its result (activationId, duration, response.result). If the action runs longer than `timeout`, only the activationId is returned — fetch the outcome later with ncloud_functions_get_action_activation_detail. web/sequence-web actions cannot handle raw HTTP here; use an API Gateway trigger for that.

actionName.description: Name of the action to invoke

params.description: Runtime parameters passed to the action (highest precedence)

platform.description: Platform (default: vpc). Singapore/Japan regions support vpc only.

timeout.description: Max time to wait for the response in ms (0-60000, default 60000)

name: ncloud_functions_invoke_action
